s: Not to steal the OP's thunder, but I recently got the 12" Stingray and it's as good as the 14" KW Sport Flare that I replaced. In fact, I think the Stingray sits about 1/2" higher when measured from top of shield to top of vent on my '16 RGS w/stock seat. I'm 6'1" w/32" inseam and tend to slouch when I ride, but I have no problem seeing over it. For the money, it's a good buy IMO.
